mapper.insert: insert into product(seller_id, category_id, address_id, name, description, price, quantity, condition, status, creat_time, update_time) values (#{sellerId}, #{categoryId}, #{addressId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{quantity}, #{condition}, #{status}, #{creatTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from product order by creat_time desc
select * from product order by creat_time desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select * from product where seller_id = #{sellerId} order by creat_time desc
select * from product where category_id = #{categoryId} order by creat_time desc
mapper.update: update product set quantity = #{quantity}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
